questions.title: Simple Inheritance
questions.description: Write a Java program with an Animal class (with name field and speak() method) and a Dog class that extends Animal. Override speak() to print 'Woof!'. Create a Dog named 'Buddy' and make it speak.
hints: Call super() in constructor if needed

questions.title: Super Keyword Usage
questions.description: Write a Vehicle class with brand field and a constructor. Write a Car class that extends Vehicle, adds a model field, and uses super() to call the parent constructor. Create a Car with brand 'Toyota' and model 'Camry'.
hints: Child can access parent fields via super

questions.title: Polymorphism Demo
questions.description: Write a Shape class with an abstract area() method. Create Circle and Rectangle subclasses that implement area(). Create an array of Shape references containing different shapes and calculate total area using polymorphism.
constraints: Shape is abstract with abstract area()
Use Shape[] array with mixed objects

examples.output:
Circle area: 78.54
Rectangle area: 20.0
Total area: 98.54

hints: abstract class Shape { abstract double area(); }
Loop through Shape[] and call area()

questions.title: Interface Implementation
questions.description: Write a Drawable interface with a draw() method. Create Circle and Square classes that implement Drawable. Create objects and call draw() on each.

examples.output:
Drawing a circle with radius 5
Drawing a square with side 4

hints: Interface methods are public abstract by default
questions.expectedOutput:
Drawing a circle
Drawing a square

questions.title: Multiple Interfaces
questions.description: Write two interfaces: Flyable (with fly() method) and Swimmable (with swim() method). Create a Duck class that implements both interfaces. Demonstrate a duck that can both fly and swim.

examples.output:
Duck is flying!
Duck is swimming!

hints: Implement all methods from both interfaces
questions.expectedOutput:
Duck is flying!
Duck is swimming!
